lines.en: Oh, the GPS says we should take 495 to 270,
but check out this cool alternate route.
- Oh my God, that is so interesting to me
because I am a map salesman.
- Please don't. - That's what you do when you--
- Please don't do, oh great, here comes a guy.
- Excuse me, why aren't we moving?
- Exit's closed for a bit, residential motorcade.
- Just shut off the car 'til it opens up.
Why do you have so many soundtracks?
- Oh, well, I kind of look at it like
it's your favorite directors making a mixtape just for you.
- Oh no, I probably don't want to listen to that.
- Yes, I want to listen to it.
- No. - I want to listen to it.
I want to hear my time.
- Here I go, here I go, here I go.
- Data had never felt this way before.
Of course, Data had never felt anything before.
But Captain Picard couldn't help but note the smile
that crept over his mechanical but life-like face.
As they walked down the hall into the bridge...
No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
- That was a great road trip.
- Yeah, well, at least it took a million hours
and it was 180 degrees and we starved to death.
Hey, how about next weekend we fly to Pawnee?
- Ah, never mind, I don't feel like it.
